sections.content: You know the simple future from A2 Unit 19. Use it to make predictions about society and to describe what will happen later.

items.spanish: La tecnología tendrá un papel importante.
items.english: Technology will have an important role.

items.spanish: Muchas profesiones desaparecerán y otras nuevas aparecerán.
items.english: Many professions will disappear and other new ones will appear.

sections.content: For predictions with no fixed time, the simple future fits better than *ir a* + infinitive, which suggests a nearer, already planned future.
